subject: financial_literacy
concept: Building a simple plan to pay off a small debt within a set timeframe
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student calculates monthly payments needed to pay off a small simulated debt within a chosen number of months
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a debt payoff timeline to its required monthly payment amount
exercise.abstract: Student creates a simple payoff plan for a given debt amount and timeframe

misconception_flags: calculates a monthly payment that wouldn't actually pay off the full debt within the stated timeframe

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
